title: Exciting Updates: Next Major Release & Supporting Our Mission
message:
Dear Vision Assistant Community,

I am actively putting the finishing touches on the next major release of Vision Assistant Pro! This upcoming version brings significant performance optimizations, refined multimodal tools, and support for the latest next-generation AI models to deliver the fastest and most reliable accessibility experience.

Vision Assistant Pro is completely free and open-source for tens of thousands of blind and visually impaired users worldwide. However, researching and testing new AI models, continuous software engineering, and maintaining high quality standards require substantial time and resources. If Vision Assistant brings value to your daily life, your voluntary contributions directly empower this project to stay independent and actively maintained.

Supported Regions & Currencies:
Due to international payment processing logistics, I can currently only accept contributions in the following currencies:
• USD (United States)
• EUR (European Union / SEPA)
• GBP (United Kingdom)
• CAD (Canada)
• AUD (Australia)

Payment Methods & Important Notice:
• European Bank Transfer (SEPA / IBAN): Direct transfer for EUR.
• PayPal: Available for USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, and AUD. (Please note: Due to exchange intermediary policies and transfer fees, the minimum acceptable amount via PayPal is 20 USD or its equivalent).

How to Contribute:
Because active receiving accounts are generated dynamically on demand:
1. Send a brief email to visionassistantpro@proton.me specifying the exact amount and currency you wish to contribute.
(Important: Please do NOT send funds directly to this email address on PayPal, as it is strictly an administrative contact address and not a registered PayPal account).
2. You will receive the active, verified payment details (temporary PayPal address or European SEPA IBAN) valid for 48 hours to complete the transfer safely.

(You can also access donation details anytime via: NVDA Menu > Tools > Vision Assistant > Donate)

Thank you sincerely for your trust, encouragement, and support in advancing visual AI accessibility for everyone!

Warm regards,
Mahmood Hozhabri
